notes: Hydrated handoff intent: This task owns Exam 1 preparation, not HW3 completion. The exam is Thursday October 22, 2026 and Xu stated live on October 8 that Q1 is True/False and Q2-Q5 are short homework/class-example-style problems. He named simple DFA, simple NFA, regex work, CFG design, PDA design, show RL pumping property, show CFL pumping property, use pumping lemma to prove not regular, and use CFL pumping lemma to prove not context free. Xu said the exam is 75 minutes, there are no longer-response questions, and students should redo HW/class examples independently without solutions; if they can do that, they should be able to do the exam. For pumping-property questions, partition + verification of the 3 conditions is enough; HW3-style explanatory prose is not needed. For nonregular/non-CFL pumping proofs, cover all legal splits/placements. Current concrete anchors include L7 `a(bb)*a` for RL pumpability; Lecture 11 equal-a/b `aabb`/`abab` for CFL pumpability; canonical `{0^n1^n}` and current RL handout for nonregularity; Lecture 11 `{a^n b^n c^n}` plus Fall-2026 handout `{a^i b^j c^k | 0<=i<=j<=k}` and `{ww}` for non-CFL proofs; HW3 CFG/PDA constructions; HW1 DFA/NFA/regex constructions. Q1 should protect exact distinctions such as DFA completeness, NFA existential acceptance, DFA=NFA power, DPDA<PDA, regular iff DFA/NFA/regex, CFL iff CFG/PDA, one-way pumping implications, 5 closure operations vs 3 named regular operations, epsilon/empty-set traps, ambiguity levels, CNF forms, failure-to-construct not being proof, and explicit exclusions. CYK is syllabus-listed, Lecture-10-required reading, and current Canvas-distributed, but user explicitly says Xu had not substantively taught it live by the end of Lecture 11; future transcript/L12/review must resolve weight. Full CNF conversion procedure is explicitly excluded; proofs of Lemmas 2.21 and 2.27 are excluded. The user has one US Letter page double-sided for the cheat sheet. Cheat-sheet architecture should be two functional regions: Q1 rapid T/F protection and Q2-Q5 compact execution recipes. MILCOM: fly Sunday night Oct 11, present Wednesday, return Thursday night Oct 15; professor told user to put academics on hold for MILCOM. MTH 602 gets Oct 16-18; midterm is Oct 19 at 11 AM. CIS resumes after that. Oct 20 is expected review; Oct 22 CIS midterm. HW3 is already tutoring-complete/submission-integrated and artifact-validated; use its learning record, do not redo it as unfinished work. Behavioral priority: fresh CFG design because equal-count CFG required guidance; fresh PDA mechanics because complete artifact required JFLAP/read-pop-push/bottom-marker guidance; regular pumping witness selection because HW2 exposed a weakness; fresh CFL non-CFL case analysis because it is new; and at least one DFA/NFA/regex transfer because Xu named those families and several HW1 skills remain guided. Historical 2019 material is useful predictive evidence only. Preserve source provenance rigorously. Quote only actual/near-verbatim transcript/source wording; paraphrases stay unquoted.
